info.title: Seisan API
info.description:
Seisan is a free shared-expense tracker for groups. It keeps project members, expenses, transfers, and settlements in a shared ledger so everyone can see the current balance.

Use the API to build integrations for Seisan projects, members, balances, records, and spending categories. Authenticate requests with `Authorization: Bearer $SEISAN_API_KEY`.

post.summary: Append a record to a project
post.description: Appends an immutable expense, transfer, promise, or revert entry. The supplied cent-denominated delta must match the server-derived effect and sum to zero. A transfer may set settle=true to best-effort advance an already-viewed settlement plan when the caller confirms their complete cached sender batch; the flag is not persisted in the record.
